title: feat(app-shell): the flow runner names the flow by its served label, translated (objectui#11092)
body:
Fixes #11092

Clause-②: yes

The objectui half (stage 2) of objectstack-ai/objectstack#20318: the screen-flow runner reads the app bundle's `flows.FLOW.label` and the served `flowLabel`, and names the flow by them.

## What changes

- `FlowRunner` resolves the flow's display name in the card's order: the active language's `flows.FLOW.label`, then the served `flowLabel`, then `flowName`. The first two steps are the spec's own `translateFlow` (`@objectstack/spec/system`), handed the served label as the authored literal and fed the same `activeFlowsBundle` read that `localizeScreen` already uses. There is no second loader and no hand-typed bundle address.
- One resolved value, two display slots: a line above the screen heading in the dialog header, and the `flow` parameter of the completion toast (`flowRunner.completed`), in place of the API name. No i18n key is added or changed.
- `interpretFlowResponse` lifts `flowLabel` once (`servedFlowLabel`, a `typeof` read of the one member the contract declares) onto its `paused` and `done` arms, and `judgeFlowLaunch` carries it on the `screen` follow-up. Both app-shell launch hosts pass it into `ScreenFlowState`. On resume, a paused answer replaces the runner's held label, and the toast names the flow from the `done` answer's label.
- `FlowRunsPage` (the developer Test Run panel) passes the trigger answer's `flowLabel` on both of its open paths: Run, and Continue run.

## Landing site

As the dispatch expected: `packages/app-shell/src/views/FlowRunner.tsx`, `packages/app-shell/src/utils/flowResponse.ts`, the two app-shell hosts (`useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx`, `RecordDetailView.tsx`), and `apps/console/src/pages/developer/FlowRunsPage.tsx`, each with tests beside it.

## Dispatch assumptions, measured

1. **Held.** The installed `@objectstack/spec` is 17.6.0 (lockfile and `node_modules`). Its `dist/contracts/index.d.ts` declares `flowLabel?: string` on `AutomationResult`, and the trigger response schema in `dist/automation-api.zod-*.d.ts` carries `flowLabel` as an optional `z.ZodString`. Every new read is typed by the contract (`Pick` of `AutomationResult` on the key `flowLabel`, or its indexed type). Nothing re-declares the field.
2. **The card's two-host list was incomplete, as suspected.** `FlowRunsPage` builds a `ScreenFlowState` at two sites from `client.automation.execute`. In the installed `@objectstack/client` 17.6.0 that call resolves to the unwrapped `AutomationResult` from the same trigger door, so it carries `flowLabel`. Threaded at both sites.
3. **Held.** `interpretFlowResponse` is where both launch hosts and the resume classify an answer. It is internal (not exported from the package entry), so lifting there widens no published type. The `refused` arm is deliberately not lifted, because nothing it opens names the flow: the launch refusal notice is titled with the action's own label.
4. **Held.** The toast passes the resolved label in `flow`, and no new key is needed. The bundle access is the existing `activeFlowsBundle`, read once per render and shared by `localizeScreen` and the label.
5. **Header slot (left open by the card; my choice).** The label goes in a small muted line (`text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground`) above the `DialogTitle`. The title stays the step's own heading (or the `flowRunner.title` fallback), so it is still the dialog's accessible name and every existing heading pin holds. I considered showing the label in place of the `Input` fallback on untitled screens and did not take it, because that changes the accessible name and leaves `flowRunner.title` effectively unreachable.

## Widened public surface (Clause-②)

- `ScreenFlowState`, exported from `@object-ui/app-shell`, gains one optional member: `flowLabel`. The interface now extends `Pick` of `AutomationResult` on the key `flowLabel`, so the member is an optional string and carries the contract's own TSDoc. (Generic arguments are written out in words here because GitHub strips angle-bracket spans from PR bodies.)
- `FlowRunnerProps.state` accepts the new member through that type.
- No prop, export or i18n key is added or removed, and no existing member changes type.

## Against an older backend

A backend older than objectstack-ai/objectstack#20633 serves no `flowLabel`. The header line and the toast then show the API name, the chain's last step, unless the bundle translates `flows.FLOW.label` for the active language. The existing toast pins (`Flow "convert_lead" completed`, `Flow "quote_generation" completed`) are this case, and they are unchanged.

## Tests

Pins:
- New `FlowRunner.flowLabel-11092.test.tsx`, beside `FlowRunner.flowsTranslation-5920.test.tsx`. Each case checks the header line and the toast. A zh-CN bundle gives the translation. In `en`, the served label. For an untranslated flow (with the bundle live for the screen heading), the authored label. With no served label, the API name. A paused resume answer carries its label forward.
- `flowResponse.test.ts`: the lift on `paused` and `done`, `undefined` for an absent or non-string value, and the `screen` follow-up.
- One paused-launch pin in each host harness (`useConsoleActionRuntime.refusedLaunch-9973`, `RecordDetailView.refusedLaunch-9973`), and one in `FlowRunsPage.test.tsx` covering both open paths.

Runs (local, through the shared verify lock; CI runs the full farm):
- At `5c65546`, before the merge: the touched files, 5 files / 51 tests passed. The whole `packages/app-shell/` package: 1001 files passed and 1 skipped; 9941 tests passed and 9 skipped. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` exit 0, and the test program includes all four touched app-shell test files (`--listFilesOnly`). `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell lint`: 0 errors, and no warning on any of the 385 lines this diff adds. Console: `type-check` exit 0, `lint` 0 errors and no warning on the 34 added lines, and `FlowRunsPage.test.tsx` plus `loadLanguage.test.tsx` 2 files / 8 tests passed.
- After merging `origin/main` (`1c2e2c4`, objectui#11624) as merge commit `6950ab0`: the dependency closure was rebuilt for the merged packages. The touched files plus `loadLanguage.test.tsx`: 6 files / 56 tests passed. Both `type-check`s exit 0, and console `lint` 0 errors. The whole `packages/app-shell/` rerun: 1000 files passed and 1 failed, with 9940 tests passed. The one failure is `AppContent.deniedVsUnpublished.test.tsx`, which this diff does not touch. Its network-escape guard tripped on a real `localhost:3000/api/v1/meta` read, the file installs no fetch double, and run alone at `6950ab0` it passes 15/15. It also passed in the first whole-package run. See Acceptance notes.
- Gates at `6950ab0`, each run with its own verdict line: `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:installed-pin-claims`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` and `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`: all exit 0. `scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the 11 changed paths answers NOT GOVERNED.

## Ablation (one-shot, at `5c65546`; nothing left in the tree)

Each leg was run with `ablation-replace.mjs`: a literal anchor that must hit once, the mutation and its marker counted on disk while the run held it, and a restore from `HEAD` proven by the blob hash and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The expected red/green split was written down before each run.
- **A: the resolver returns `flowName`** (it ignores the bundle and the served label). 7 red: zh, en, untranslated and resume in the runner file, plus the three host pins. The no-label pin and the four lift pins stay green.
- **B: the lift returns `undefined`.** 8 red: three lift pins, both app-shell host pins, and en, untranslated and resume in the runner file. The zh pin stays green because the bundle still wins, `FlowRunsPage` stays green because it does not route through `interpretFlowResponse`, and so do the no-label and absent/non-string pins.

## Acceptance notes

- `origin/main` was merged once, as merge commit `6950ab0`. The source of this PR's own files is identical before and after the merge.
- After this lands and the objectstack console pin moves past it, objectstack-ai/objectstack#20318 flips its ledger row. That flip is not part of this PR.
- `AppContent.deniedVsUnpublished.test.tsx` passes alone but can trip the network-escape guard under whole-package load, because it never stubs the meta probe's fetch. This is outside this card's scope. carrier: none.
- In `FlowRunsPage`, `client` is typed `any`, so the new read there is as untyped as the page's existing `status` / `runId` / `screen` reads.
